description: Permanently delete a page type and its custom-field schema - there is no trash and no undo. Refused for system types, for a type any page still uses, and for a type used by pages in the trash - move or delete those pages first, and restore_page or permanently delete the trashed ones. No page is changed by this call. To rename it or change its fields instead, use update_page_type. Returns { deleted }.

pageTypeId.description: Page type id to delete, from list_page_types

name: delete_page_type
title: Delete page type
